event_name: Date 14 April 2019 Time 11:43 2019 CHINESE GRAND PRIX 11 - 14 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 27), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 23.5 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The gearbox of car 23 has been changed before 6 consecutive events have expired. This penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is starting from the Pit Lane.
rules_referenced: Article 17.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 23 Gearbox
